target_state: Every regulated evidence item remains in its approved governed store and carries a digest-bound repository reference.

boundary.protected_state: Regulated evidence remains access-controlled, attributable, and retained under the approved policy.
boundary.explicit_constraint: Raw regulated evidence must not enter Git history.

replacement_behavior.trigger: A collaborator needs to reference regulated evidence from repository material.
replacement_behavior.safe_action: Store the evidence in the approved governed system and record a redacted manifest with an opaque locator and digest.
replacement_behavior.recovery_route: Quarantine an exposed artifact, rotate affected access material, and route the incident through the accountable security and Quality review.

verification.method: Run repository secret-shape and artifact-locator checks, then review the governed evidence receipt.
verification.success_criteria: The repository contains only a redacted manifest and digest-bound locator, and the evidence receipt resolves under least-privilege access.
